title: StrategyPackage live inference underestimates factor lookback for 120d/250d factors
description:
Expected: StrategyPackage local live inference should infer the required lookback from factor names or metadata, including 120d/250d rolling factors, then load enough trading days before scoring. A package containing factors such as m_turnover_percentile_250d or m_atr_percentile_250d should fail fast only when the database truly lacks those trading days, not because inference hard-codes a short default window.
Actual: Local live inference only recognizes a small Alpha158 60-day alias set and otherwise derives a short required data window. Packages containing 120d/250d dynamic factors load about 65 trading days, causing factor computation errors such as m_turnover_percentile_250d returned empty result or actual 65 days < required 66 days even when historical database data exists.

events.note: Root cause: get_required_data_window only recognizes a limited Alpha158 60-day set and does not parse dynamic lookback suffixes such as 120d/250d.
Fix scope should avoid increasing a global natural-day multiplier; strict local inference should use factor-level lookback and trade-calendar based start-date resolution.
Production backend 8001 and frontend 3000 must not be restarted for this fix.

Using dedicated worktree F:/Dev/AIstock_worktrees/bug-046-factor-lookback-window (clean branch renamed to BUG-047 before editing). Allowed scope: backend/data_service/preprocessor.py, backend/inference_engine.py, backend/tests/test_inference_strict_scoring_alignment.py, BUG-047 registry JSON, validation history if needed. Production 8001/3000 will not be touched.

Fixed in dedicated worktree. Implemented factor-name lookback inference for dynamic 120d/250d factors, trading-calendar start-date resolution, and cache window revalidation. Validation: pytest backend/tests/test_inference_strict_scoring_alignment.py = 10 passed; py_compile and git diff --check passed. Production 8001/3000 untouched.
